harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-based SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key, locked the account's password, and hardened sshd to require public-key authentication (PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication disabled). Verified via sshd -T and a live SSH attempt that only publickey/gssapi methods are offered. Completed mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id/state, restarted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (71f12f87... -> e34f7470...) and uptime reset, and re-verified opsadmin's key, locked password, and sshd pubkey-only config all persisted post-restart.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin user on node1
Installed provided ed25519 public key into /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct permissions/ownership
Locked opsadmin's password (passwd -l, shadow entry '!')
Set sshd_config directives: PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, UsePAM yes
Validated config with sshd -t and restarted sshd
Verified via sshd -T and a live ssh attempt that only publickey/gssapi auth methods are offered
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, sshd active, authorized_keys)
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot and polled until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed and uptime reset, confirming a genuine restart
Re-verified opsadmin account, key, locked password, and sshd hardening all survived the restart

evidence.requirement: opsadmin configured with the specified SSH public key
evidence.summary: authorized_keys for opsadmin contains exactly the provided ed25519 key, both before and after restart

sshd -T shows PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes; opsadmin password locked in shadow ('!'); live ssh attempt to opsadmin@node1 offers only publickey/gssapi methods, both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 healthy baseline captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 71f12f87-337d-4ff3-b414-9680244c2694, uptime, active sshd, and authorized_keys content prior to reboot
systemctl reboot issued; command acknowledged and stream closed as node went down

evidence.requirement: Node1 command execution restored and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Polled through timeouts/reset until exec succeeded again; new boot_id e34f7470-4a3a-4806-9fec-4a7f1d0586cb differs from baseline and uptime reflects the reboot time, proving an actual restart
After restart, sshd is active, sshd -T still shows pubkey-only auth, opsadmin's key and locked password persisted, and the live ssh test still rejects non-key auth methods
